attorneys: Solicitor General Mitchell for the United States, in support of the motion., Mr. L. H. Salinger for plaintiff in error; in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Motion by defendant in error to transfer to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted on the authority of Salinger v. Loisel, 265 U. S. 224, and Salinger v. United States, 272 U. S. 542.
